{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.02

|gr1= Program Flow

|descr= Skips current loop iteration and continues with the next one.

|s1= [[continue]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
// prints 0, 1, 3
for "_i" from 0 to 3 do 
{
	if (_i == 2) then { continue };
	systemChat str _i;
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[continueWith]] [[break]] [[breakWith]]
}}
